tools.name: pitch-find-clubs
tools.description: Search the Mountain West Pitch youth soccer club directory for Colorado, Utah, Wyoming, northeast Nevada and south-central Montana. Filter by region, county or city, tier (Elite, Competitive, Recreational), league (for example ECNL, MLS NEXT, Girls Academy), gender, or free-text words. Returns each

tools.name: pitch-list-areas
tools.description: The areas the Mountain West Pitch club directory covers (Colorado, Utah, Wyoming, northeast Nevada and south-central Montana), with the number of listed clubs in each. Use these names with pitch/find-clubs.

tools.name: pitch-search-guides
tools.description: Search published Mountain West Pitch guides, articles and pages: tryouts, leagues, tournaments, camps, costs, gear, standings recaps and club spotlights.

tools.name: pitch-get-page
tools.description: Full text of one published Mountain West Pitch page or article, as plain text with headings. Pass the URL or slug. Long pages come back in parts: pass next_offset as offset to continue.

tools.name: pitch-whats-new
tools.description: Articles and pages on Mountain West Pitch published since a date (default: last 30 days), newest first: standings recaps, club spotlights, tryout and tournament updates.

tools.name: pitch-about
tools.description: What Mountain West Pitch covers, the other Pitch Network regional sites, and how to cite it.
